recoveryWorkouts.title: Light Active Recovery
recoveryWorkouts.description: Gentle movement to promote blood flow and recovery

exercises.name: Easy Walk or Light Jog
exercises.instruction: Very easy movement to warm up. Should feel effortless and restorative.

exercises.name: Light Cardio (Bike/Walk/Swim)
exercises.instruction: Maintain a pace where you can hold a conversation easily. This promotes blood flow without adding stress.

exercises.name: Full Body Mobility Flow
exercises.instruction: Gentle mobility work focusing on areas of tightness. Use slow, controlled movements with deep breathing.
exercises.notes: Focus on hips, shoulders, and thoracic spine

recoveryWorkouts.title: Yoga Flow Recovery
recoveryWorkouts.description: Restorative yoga sequence for deep recovery and flexibility

exercises.name: Restorative Yoga Flow
exercises.instruction: Move through sun salutations, downward dog, pigeon pose, and warrior sequences with controlled breathing. Focus on breath-to-movement synchronization.
exercises.goal: Improve flexibility, promote recovery, and enhance mind-body connection
exercises.trainerNotes: Focus on breath-to-movement synchronization. Never force a stretch—find your edge and breathe into it. This is recovery work, not a competition.

flowSteps.name: Sun Salutations
flowSteps.instruction: Flow through 5 rounds of sun salutations to warm up the body

flowSteps.name: Downward Dog → Pigeon Pose
flowSteps.instruction: Hold downward dog for 1 min, then transition to pigeon pose on each side for 1 min

flowSteps.name: Warrior Sequence
flowSteps.instruction: Warrior I → Warrior II → Reverse Warrior, hold each for 30 seconds

flowSteps.name: Cat-Cow
flowSteps.instruction: Slow, controlled cat-cow movements for spinal mobility

flowSteps.name: Child's Pose
flowSteps.instruction: Rest in child's pose, focusing on deep breathing and relaxation

exercises.name: Breathing Reset
exercises.instruction: Lie on back, 4-count inhale through nose, 6-count exhale through mouth. Focus on complete relaxation.

recoveryWorkouts.title: Mobility & Flexibility Focus
recoveryWorkouts.description: Targeted mobility work to address tightness and improve range of motion

exercises.name: Light Movement
exercises.instruction: Easy walk or light movement to warm up tissues

exercises.name: Hip Mobility Circuit
exercises.instruction: Hip circles (10 each direction), 90/90 hip switches (10 reps), leg swings (10 each), hip flexor stretches (60s each)

exercises.name: Thoracic & Shoulder Mobility
exercises.instruction: Thoracic rotations (10 each side), shoulder dislocates (10 reps), arm circles (10 each direction), doorway chest stretch (60s)

exercises.name: Full Body Stretch
exercises.instruction: Hamstring stretch (60s each), quad stretch (60s each), piriformis/glute stretch (60s each), lat/shoulder stretch (60s)

recoveryWorkouts.title: Foam Rolling & Recovery
recoveryWorkouts.description: Self-myofascial release and light movement for recovery

exercises.name: Foam Rolling Sequence
exercises.instruction: Roll quads (1 min each side), IT band (1 min each side), glutes (1 min), lats (1 min), thoracic spine (1 min). Focus on areas of tightness.

exercises.name: Easy Walk
exercises.instruction: Light walk to promote blood flow after rolling

recoveryWorkouts.title: Breathwork & Meditation
recoveryWorkouts.description: Recovery through breathing exercises and mental restoration

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.instruction: 4-count inhale, 4-count hold, 4-count exhale, 4-count hold. Repeat for 5 minutes.

exercises.name: Deep Breathing Reset
exercises.instruction: Lie on back, 4-count inhale through nose, 6-count exhale through mouth. Focus on complete relaxation and letting go of tension.

exercises.name: Guided Meditation
exercises.instruction: Body scan meditation: focus attention on each body part, releasing tension as you go. Start from toes and work up to head.

exercises.name: Light Swim or Pool Work
exercises.instruction: If pool available: light swimming, water walking, or gentle pool exercises. Great for joint decompression and low-impact movement.

exercises.name: Light Land Movement
exercises.instruction: If no pool: light walk or easy bike at conversational pace
